nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Design-source index of the Policy Workbench prototype: a navigable deck that frames each prototype screen in an iframe with Back/Next controls, notes on the single design system, and a light/dark mode switch.

nodes.name: mode.js
nodes.summary: Light/dark mode switcher shared by prototype screens: picks the mode from ?mode, then localStorage, then dark, and toggles the html class and any mode-toggle button labels and icons.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-invoking function (IIFE) that runs before DOMContentLoaded to avoid a flash of the wrong theme.

nodes.name: shell.js
nodes.summary: Defines the global WB object that injects the shared admin chrome (header, sub-header, nav rail) from admin-sources.html into prototype admin screens via WB.top() and WB.nav().

nodes.name: tw-config.js
nodes.summary: Tailwind CDN configuration shared by every prototype screen and the Workbench page: class-based dark mode and a Material-style color palette mapped to tokens.css custom properties.

nodes.name: user-shell.js
nodes.summary: Defines the global WBU object rendering the user-facing page chrome, including the organization-policy strip that illustrates the policy lookup order (--policy, AIH_ORG_POLICY, aih-org-policy.json) selectable via ?source.

nodes.name: workbench.css
nodes.summary: Local presentation rules the Workbench page adds on top of the prototype stylesheets: Material Symbols axes, a hidden-scrollbar fading kind-filter strip, provenance marker hiding, and theme-change transition handling.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Main HTML page of the Policy Workbench: loads fonts, tokens, mode and Tailwind config, prototype and local stylesheets, and defines every element (masthead, source rails, catalog ledger, governance pane, organization modal) that main.js wires up.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Tailwind via CDN with a shared runtime config and loads the app as a single ES module (main.js).

nodes.name: acceptance-sweep.mjs
nodes.summary: Browserless acceptance sweep against a running preview's /api/* endpoints, replaying the Governance pane's call order to check no filesystem paths leak, session sharing, reopen round-trips, and refusal of bad sessions or bodies.

nodes.name: compare.html
nodes.summary: Layout-parity tool that renders the prototype and the implementation side by side or overlaid (difference blend) at the same 1600x1000 viewport to compare element geometry.

nodes.name: inspect-dom.mjs
nodes.summary: Reads a headless-rendered DOM dump of the preview page and prints acceptance facts such as the catalog error element, masthead, provenance strip, counts, and source rails.

nodes.name: probe-http.mjs
nodes.summary: Sends raw byte-exact HTTP requests over a socket to the preview server with malformed and traversal paths, then confirms the server still serves the catalog index afterwards.

nodes.name: probe-old-handler.mjs
nodes.summary: Reproduces the malformed-URL bug by running the pre-fix static server handler (unguarded decodeURIComponent) on a throwaway port and sending raw requests to it.

nodes.name: probe-shell-quoting.mjs
nodes.summary: Throwaway probe checking how spawnSync with and without shell:true quotes a JavaScript expression argument on the current platform.

nodes.name: core-targets.mjs
nodes.summary: Service module exposing the AI CLI targets Core supports, read from @aihq/core's public SUPPORTED_CLIS export and validated; loaded on demand by core-service.mjs.

nodes.name: post
nodes.summary: Posts a JSON body to a preview API route and returns the status and parsed response for the sweep's checks.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Opens a raw TCP socket, sends a hand-built GET request for the given path, and resolves with the parsed HTTP status and byte count.

nodes.name: oldServer
nodes.summary: Recreates the pre-fix static file server whose unguarded decodeURIComponent threw on malformed percent escapes.

nodes.name: raw
nodes.summary: Sends a raw GET request over a socket to the old handler and reports what came back.

nodes.name: coreTargets
nodes.summary: Validates @aihq/core's SUPPORTED_CLIS as a non-empty, duplicate-free list of well-formed target ids and returns a copy of it.
